paragraphs: What should I watch tonight? Three movies or shows you haven't seen, that fit your taste (Qloo), and that ordinary viewers actually liked (our Real People Score). Ask in the app, or just say it out loud.

Critics and star ratings tell you what reviewers think. Tonight's Pick reads what real viewers already said online, adjusts for genre, and pairs that with Qloo's taste graph so the pick is both good and yours.
One codebase, entered in three hackathons: the Qloo Agentic Hackathon, the Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon and the Amazon Developer Hackathon (Alexa+ track). Each entry links its own git tag.
features: Qloo knows taste, not reception. It can say fans of Hereditary also like The Witch, but not whether regular viewers walked away happy.
The Real People Score knows reception, not taste. It can say 74% of viewers liked a film, but not whether you will.
Together: Qloo proposes taste-matched candidates; the score ranks them by how real viewers felt, judged against their own genre.

requirements.text: Everything works as a guest, with no login.
Optional sign-in (Google/GitHub, merging the guest profile) is not wired into the web app yet; the API's merge endpoint exists.
